email.tagline: Find where what you love meets what you're good at
email.bodyVerify: Use this verification code to continue. It expires in 10 minutes.
email.bodyReset: Use this password reset code to continue. It expires in 10 minutes.
email.ignore: If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.
email.bodyEmailChange: Use this code to confirm this address as your new Wikigai email. It expires in 10 minutes.
email.bodyEmailChanged: The email of your Wikigai account was changed to {email}. Your results and saved items are kept. If you didn't do this, reply to this email or reset your password straight away.
email.bodyDelete: Someone asked to permanently delete the Wikigai account linked to this email, with all its data. If it was you, enter this code on the deletion page. It expires in 10 minutes.
email.subjectDeleted: Your Wikigai account and data were deleted
email.bodyDeleted: As you asked, your Wikigai account and all its data (profile, answers, results, plans and saved videos) have been permanently deleted. Encrypted backups roll over automatically and no longer contain it after 30 days at most. You are welcome back any time.
